Website terms

Use of this website

This website provides information about the Business Playbook Series and related educational resources. Its content is general business information and does not replace advice suited to your circumstances.

Book descriptions, original resources and other publisher content are protected by applicable intellectual property law. Free resources may be downloaded for your own use; permission is required for resale or redistribution unless a resource states otherwise.

External sellers set and administer their own prices, availability, delivery, refunds and transaction terms. Review those terms before purchasing. The website does not process payments.

Accuracy and availability

The publisher aims to keep information accurate but may update descriptions, links and availability. Nothing on this website guarantees a financial or business result.

Review before public launch

The publisher must review these terms for the final business arrangements, applicable law and contact details before public launch. Product-specific licences, refund policies and other sale terms must be added if direct sales are introduced.
